title: pinguicula vulgaris subsp. leptoceras
intro: Pinguicula vulgaris subsp. leptoceras, commonly known as the 'Long-lipped Butterwort', is a carnivorous plant species belonging to the family Lentibulariaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinguicula vulgaris subsp. leptoceras are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health and its potential therapeutic applications.
